title: Tensor-route computation on K-flat pullback representatives
statement: For prime ℓ, normed E over ℚ_ℓ, f:X→Y, an explicit ordinary monoidal structure m, a proof that pullback preserves flat objects, and a homotopy complex P whose ordinary pullback is K-flat, the residue exchange tensor comparison equation holds with m-induced derived monoidal structure.

proof.text: Expand the derived tensor comparison on the K-flat representative, normalize the fixed coefficient presentation through the symmetry isomorphism and apply its counit identity; identify the remaining ordinary composite with the tensor-model map.

proof_origin.note: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: arbitrary m changes the derived tensorator, while the displayed model map fixes the canonical m. Negating a strong monoidal structure gives an odd-residue-characteristic counterexample. Lean attachment withdrawn; canonical parent is proved directly without this node.
